ModuleDescription.description:
Speech input is handled through Azure Cognitive Services Speech to Text, verbal commands have to be prefaced with "Sallie". Text entered via the dialogue box, is inputted directly, doesn't need to include "Sallie."
Sometimes the results from Speech Recognition well include words before the "Sallie" keyword. Everythought up to and including "Sallie" is disregarded.
Dialogue Contents: Enable Speech Recognition Checkbox: Pause or Resume Speech Recognition Text Box: When pressing enter, any text is processed the same as Speech Recognition Results. Radio Buttons: Select Local or remote Mic Open Command File: Opens up a text file. Each line is a seperate phrase. A special command of pause <x> can be used where x is the number of cycles to wait.
Works together with SpeechParser, PhraseRecognizer, QueryResolution and SpeechOut to functions as Sallie's ability to hear and speak.

This dialog creates a Link between two Relastionships connected by a Clause Type. This can be used to create conditioinan links by using the clause type "if". That is, enter Mary can play outside if weather is sunny. This link will only be added to search results if the condition, weather is sunny, is true.
This module iintended to provide input/test data for visual recognition. It performs generic CV algorithms to locate corners in a simple visual input.
This module allows the system to save shapes and retrieve them by content.

This Agent scans the UKS Object tree looking for object Children which have common attributes which can be "bubbled" up to the parent.
Given a number of dogs, some of which are defined as having 4 legs, the having-4-legs attributes can be added to the "Dog" node. This makes the original link(s) redundant and they can subsequently be removed by the "Remove Redundancy" Agent.

This module imports and exports UKS content to/from a text file in an easy-to-read format.
Import: 1. Press "Import” 2. Select a .txt file to import Content will be added to the UKS using the names of Thoughts in the text file. That way, it can append new data to existing content, but be sure that usage is consistent across multiple data sources.
Export: 1. In the UKS display dialog, select the root of the data to be saved. All descendants of that thought will be parsed and saved. 2. Press “Export” 3. Select the file location… the system will overwrite existing files.
